wikipediaReadEvidence.locator: Set-index list, line 123: “Uzziah, King of Judah, also known as Azariah.” 1 Chronicles 3:12’s Azariah is in the royal line between Amaziah and Jotham.
wikipediaReadEvidence.supportJa: The article explicitly identifies Judah’s King Uzziah as also known as Azariah. The WEB genealogy names Azariah between Amaziah and Jotham, supporting the name correspondence, though the verse itself uses Azariah.
